title: Account gate before the workspace
summary: The only page logic allowed to run before the account service confirms the creator may enter. It reads /auth/session; with cloud sign-in on, the workspace is revealed only for an account whose onboarding is complete; otherwise it starts device sign-in and polls for its result.

carrier.notes: static/v3/auth-gate.js (window.LumeriAuthGate). Its routes are answered by the Gateway and the account service (process area).

replaceability.why: It decides whether the workspace opens at all and starts sign-in; accounts and sign-in are Lumeri's foundation.
replaceability.decided: Acrab 2026-10-06 (accounts, gateway and cloud are Lumeri's); docs/luc/self-luc-inventory.md:103

operations.name: GET /auth/session
operations.notes: Transient failures are retried after 800, 2000 and 4500 ms before the creator is asked.

operations.name: POST /auth/device/token
operations.notes: Polled every interval seconds, kept within 2 to 10 seconds.

invariants.text: The workspace is hidden in the HTML until the gate grants access.
Signed out, the gate calls only auth endpoints until onboarding is complete.
Transient auth errors are retried until the service recovers.

break: the account service cannot be reached
failure.notes: The workspace stays hidden; the creator is told the service cannot be reached.
